summary: End-to-end testing of g00dweird.com Win95 retro chatroom. 14 pytest backend tests (REST + WebSocket) all PASSED. Frontend Playwright flows PASSED: login, chat send, worlds switch, upload avatar, profile (avatar pick reflected on iso world), jukebox, start menu, taskbar, drag windows, close windows. One minor observation on jukebox now-playing UI.

integration_issues.issue: Jukebox now-playing header briefly showed 't.wav by TEST_alpha' then at end-of-session screenshot displayed 'silent'. Backend WS broadcast works (verified in backend test), so UI may reset currentAudio on audio element load error for small/invalid WAV. Not blocking.

issues: When Worlds.exe overlaps Chat window on 1440 viewport, world tagline text is clipped by chat window (z-index ordering). Purely cosmetic; items still clickable.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why Jukebox UI occasionally reverts to 'silent' in now-playing heading after Play; likely due to <audio> onError clearing currentTrack. Works at backend/WS level.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py init_storage() uses 'global _storage_key' mutation but at startup runs in event loop while requests is blocking I/O — acceptable for startup but per-request put_object/get_object calls are synchronous inside async endpoints; consider wrapping with run_in_executor to avoid blocking the event loop during large uploads.
server.py currently relies on in-process ROOM_STATES dict; will not scale across multiple backend replicas — fine for single-instance preview, but document limitation.
No rate limiting or file-type validation on /api/upload beyond size and kind enum. Malicious user could upload .exe labelled audio. Consider validating content_type against kind.
No auth on WebSocket: any client knowing user_id+nickname can impersonate; acceptable given nickname-only design but worth noting.
db.messages grows unbounded — no TTL / cap; add retention policy (Mongo TTL index or capped collection).
/api/files/{path:path} returns entire file via Response(content=...) — large files fully buffered in memory; use StreamingResponse for >a few MB.
test_credentials: Nickname-only; used TEST_alpha, TEST_beta, TEST_joiner, TEST_pw, TEST_jb during testing.
seed_data_creation: Created several users (TEST_*) and uploaded tiny PNG/WAV/MP4 records during tests. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with asyncio_mode=auto (pytest.ini). Use `pytest /app/backend/tests -v`. WebSocket tests require `websockets` package (installed). Frontend public URL works via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All data-testids listed in review_request are present and functional. Jukebox now-playing may show 'silent' for invalid WAV payloads; upload a real audio file for full jukebox verification.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. Jukebox UI silent-state is likely caused by HTML5 audio load error for the tiny synthetic WAV triggering onError -> setCurrentAudio(null). Mitigation: in JukeboxWindow, do not clear track on audio element error; only clear on jukebox_stop WS event.
